scope: Nonauthor static review of frozen ephemeral Pi, evidence router/corpus, identity/privacy/source-version checks and usage accounting. No model request, test, browser, build, SSH or production operation was performed by this reviewer.
status: two P1 gaps reported to Root and author; correction review pending

findings.fact: Ephemeral metadata carries recordOnly=true, and app.beforeRun passes recordOnly into preflight. NativeUsageCollector preserves that metadata. However, recordUsage's post-insert budget check does not examine usage.recordOnly.
findings.causalCounterexample: With an existing positive dailyLimitUSD, either an already reached total or blockUnpriced plus a null current cost causes recordUsage to throw BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after recording the real response. Pi's onUsage subscriber catches it, marks the run cancelled and aborts. Thus a trusted evidence query configured for record-only/no spending cap can still be stopped by price or daily-budget policy after the first actual request.
findings.requestedNarrowFix: Bypass only the post-insert budget exception for usage.recordOnly===true; retain all accounting, unknown-price representation, pause/concurrency checks and ordinary-run behavior. Add one pure governance fixture for record-only unknown price and reached daily total.

findings.fact: The ephemeral path disables retries, compaction and cache warming, and installs no executable tools. It does not install a one-turn stop hook. The locally installed SDK converts an unexpected provider toolCall into a tool-not-found result without terminate=true; its agent loop then selects another model request unless finishTurn returns action:end.
findings.causalCounterexample: If a provider returns a toolCall despite the empty tool list, one Pi.run can issue another real model request. The router counts at most three Pi.run calls, so the stated at-most-three actual requests per query is not enforced under that response. No extra real request was executed or observed during this review; this follows from the installed SDK branch.
findings.requestedNarrowFix: For ephemeral sessions only, use the SDK's public agent.finishTurn hook to end after one response, and reject an assistant result containing any toolCall. Preserve ordinary sessions. A fake-stream SDK fixture can assert one request without calling a model.

positiveStaticObservations: Present member cookies prohibit administrator fallback, including invalid or expired member tokens. Principal binding includes identity/credential authorization state and is rechecked after awaited work.

Cloud privacy local/ask/allowed gates are enforced before model calls; explicit consent is required for ask-cloud. Selection is frozen, local requirements are checked by Pi, and current identity/privacy/source references are monitored and rechecked between stages.
Ephemeral sessions and settings are memory-only, with cacheWarming off, retries off, compaction off, no tools, extensions, skills or context files. The original ordinary-run defaults are unchanged.

Corpus access restricts memory to the current actor's active private me profile; knowledge references retain source/book revision and full-text hash. Resolution reopens authorized current content and verifies exact quote positions instead of trusting client paths.

Claims require bounded literal citations and an additional model support check. The UI presents interpretation and source quotes separately; this is not independent proof that a supported model interpretation is true.
Provider token counts are recorded from native usage; unavailable prices remain null/unavailable instead of being presented as zero. Prompt and evidence text are not fields of the usage ledger.
remainingBoundaries: This is a source review, not a semantic quality measurement or a production privacy test.
The predeclared real-model contract and its future execution remain separately owned by Root/author.
Corrections and final source hashes should be recorded in a separate final report, preserving these pending-at-time findings.
